ei.title: The Hawthorne Effect and Subject Awareness
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Researchers need to be aware that subjects' behavior may change simply because they are getting special attention, as one classic experiment revealed. In the late 1930s, the Western Electric Company hired researchers to investigate worker productivity in its Hawthorne factory near Chicago. One experiment tested the hypothesis that increasing the available lighting would raise worker output. First, researchers measured worker productivity or output (the dependent variable). Then they increased the lighting (the independent variable) and measured output a second time. Productivity had gone up, a result that supported the hypothesis. But when the research team later turned the lighting back down, productivity increased again. What was going on? In time, the researchers realized that the employees were working harder (even if they could not see as well) simply because people were focusing on them and measuring their output. From this research, social scientists coined the term Hawthorne effect to refer to a change in a subject's behavior caused simply by the awareness of being studied.

questions.passage: Researchers need to be aware that subjects' behavior may change simply because they are getting special attention, as one classic experiment revealed. In the late 1930s, the Western Electric Company hired researchers to investigate worker productivity in its Hawthorne factory near Chicago. One experiment tested the hypothesis that increasing the available lighting would raise worker output. First, researchers measured worker productivity or output (the dependent variable). Then they increased the lighting (the independent variable) and measured output a second time. Productivity had gone up, a result that supported the hypothesis. But when the research team later turned the lighting back down, productivity increased again. What was going on? In time, the researchers realized that the employees were working harder (even if they could not see as well) simply because people were focusing on them and measuring their output. From this research, social scientists coined the term Hawthorne effect to refer to a change in a subject's behavior caused simply by the awareness of __________.

det.analysis:
① measuring their output: 산출량을 측정하는 것에 대한 인식 → 맥락 부적합
② the available lighting: 조명에 대한 인식 → 맥락 부적합
③ getting special attention: 특별한 관심을 받는 것 → 원인이지 호손 효과 정의의 핵심이 아님
④ being studied: 연구 대상임을 인식함으로써 행동이 변화 → 호손 효과 정의 ←정답
